versions.changelog:
Initial release offering an auditable, evidence-based approach to patent portfolio triage and screening using transparent criteria.

- Ranks a user-defined patent universe with a 30/30/20/20 scoring model based on citations, family size, core-inventor concentration, and verified legal-event activity.
- Selects a documented 10–15% high-value screening portfolio with full traceability.
- Generates static HTML and JSON reports by default; optional Word output on request.
- Includes rigorous controls for required inputs, evidence preservation, error handling, and model transparency.
- Designed to support screening, prioritization, and review—explicitly not for patent valuation, enforceability, or investment decisions.
